model.name: Truth-decay / no-freshness-invariant family — no authoritative artifact may be stored-and-silent (derive OR revalidate+visible-stale)
model.description: An artifact EXISTS, LOOKS AUTHORITATIVE, and NOTHING keeps it TRUE/ACTIONABLE at read — a stored value or constraint with no invariant re-checking it against the reality it claims. It does not fail loud; it silently misleads and is still trusted. This is the FAMILY (>=8 measured specimens in one day, incl the design-note's own author and the PO), not N instance-fixes. The by-construction CURE, per artifact-class in priority order: (a) DERIVE-first from the single source on each read (no stored copy to rot); ELSE (b) STORED with provenance RE-VALIDATED PER READ + rendered VISIBLY STALE on failure; NEVER (c) stored-and-silent. Each class's cure is FAILABLE (R40.54): a lint/gate that RENDERS-STALE or REDs with a stub-must-fail. Per-instance fixes (R40.55 boot currency+state-removal, fact-2 derived-slot) CITE this as their family root, not duplicate.

discoverySource.corpus: >=10 specimens (+#9 standing-repeat-directive +#10 end-to-end-pairing/recorder) in one day: deploy-instruction(DEPLOY-STATE.md) / req-satisfaction(R40.50 untasked) / guard-coverage(T40.1 CURED proof) / boot-state(R40.55) / derived-slot(fact-2 46c68e1fc) / circular-ruling(PO deadlock) / relayed-measurement author-#7 + PO-#8 — pervasive enough to catch the design-note author + the PO.

model.crossRefNote: Rides the R40.54 failable-AC family: truth-decay IS the 'unenforced-wish' generalized from a single AC to over-time/at-read across artifact classes. R40.55 (boot) + R40.44 (explicit-wins-while-valid + observable-expiry) + R37.12 (revalidate-or-stale-badge) are per-class instances of cure (b). The enumerate-not-universal + class-divergence + self-application (a hand class-list rots like its artifacts) reuse the R40.55 owner-list lesson.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The family has TWO ARMS, both enforced. ARM A (WENT-STALE -> freshness): NO artifact CLASS that reads as authoritative may be STORED-AND-SILENT; it must (a) DERIVE-first from its single source each read, ELSE (b) be STORED with provenance RE-VALIDATED PER READ + rendered VISIBLY STALE + show-age on failure. ARM B (BORN-FALSE -> provenance/positive-control): NO authoritative claim may be asserted from a guess, an unvalidated instrument, or ONE HALF of a required pairing — existence of one half proves nothing. Silence (Arm A) and assert-from-one-half/unproven-instrument (Arm B) are BOTH forbidden. Arm B differs because revalidating a born-false claim re-runs the SAME wrong instrument and re-confirms it — Arm B validates the INSTRUMENT and DEMANDS THE OTHER HALF, not just freshness.

gateRef.assertion: every authoritative-artifact class resolves to Arm-A (derive OR revalidate+visible-stale) AND every negative/composed claim satisfies Arm-B (positive-control + other-half); a stored-and-silent OR born-false-unchecked class => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): (A) seed a stored-and-silent class => RED; (B) seed a negative claim with no positive-control AND a one-half composed claim => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: DERIVE-first (a) is the REQUIRED cure wherever derivation is possible; STORED-with-revalidation (b) is admissible ONLY when derivation is genuinely impossible and the artifact MUST be stored. A class that stores+revalidates where it could instead derive is a WEAKER cure than available => flagged (prefer-derive).

gateRef.assertion: a class using (b) where (a) is feasible => flagged; (b) with no revalidation OR no visible-stale => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed a derivable class that stores+revalidates instead => flagged; a (b) class missing visible-stale => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: deploy-instruction (DEPLOY-STATE.md): (a) DERIVE the instruction from BRANCH REALITY (branch-contains + main..HEAD), OR (b) stamp it with the commit-range it was true for + render STALE when HEAD moves past that range. A stored 'do NOT merge/DELETE branch' with no re-check against branch state (14 hotfix commits incl shipped v0.8.143) => the pure specimen.

gateRef.assertion: HEAD past the instruction's stated commit-range => VISIBLE STALE banner (not silent); or the instruction derives from branch-contains

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed a deploy-instruction whose stated range HEAD has passed => VISIBLE STALE (stub-must-fail: silent => RED)

acceptanceCriteria.text: req-satisfaction: (a) DERIVE 'satisfied' from a tracked COVERING TASK's state — NEVER store 'satisfied' as an authored flag. An AC with tasks[]==empty is UN-SATISFIABLE-BY-CONSTRUCTION (rides R40.54 failable family + the untasked-AC audit). Specimen: R40.50 4c4de905 had 7 ACs / tasks[]=empty, shipped falsely-satisfied v0.8.118 then reopened.

gateRef.assertion: an AC-bearing req with tasks[]==empty => RED; satisfaction derives from a covering Task's state, never an authored flag

acceptanceCriteria.text: The artifact-CLASS set is ENUMERATED (corpus >=10 specimens: deploy-instruction, req-satisfaction, guard-coverage, boot-state, derived-slot, circular-ruling/unsatisfiable-constraint, relayed-measurement x2 + standing-repeat-directive(#9) + end-to-end-pairing/assert-one-half(#10, the recorder case)) WITH a divergence/completeness check: a NEW authoritative-artifact class matching the meta-shape (authoritative-reading + nothing-validates + silent) that is NOT enrolled => flagged for triage, never silent-pass. A hand-maintained class list rots exactly like the artifacts it polices (self-application, R40.55 owner-list lesson). Each enumerated class has EITHER a dedicated gate AC OR an explicit enrolled-not-CI-gated-by-nature marking with a written reason (constraint-liveness #6 = the split case: visible-blocked half gated, authoring-satisfiability half enrolled-with-reason); an enumerated class with NEITHER a gate NOR a reasoned enrollment => the born-false coverage-claimed-nothing-enforces-it disease => RED.

gateRef.assertion: an authoritative-artifact class matching the shape but not enrolled => flagged; a hand-list with no divergence check => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed a new authoritative-artifact class (or a new born-false shape) not enrolled => triage-flag (not silent-pass)

acceptanceCriteria.text: A RELAYED MEASUREMENT (a peer's line-numbers/counts/'X absent-or-present') is itself a STORED artifact timestamped at THEIR read, not yours — it decays. It MUST be RE-DERIVED at point-of-use before being asserted as current, ESPECIALLY into a durable artifact or a report. Specimens #7 (author cited a peer's stale DEPLOY-STATE read) + #8 (PO escalated a wrong-name resolveChangeRequest grep=0 to Tron 3x). Enforcement is process-failable: a durable claim citing a measurement must carry its own point-of-use re-derivation or be marked RELAYED-UNVERIFIED.

gateRef.assertion: a durable claim asserting a measurement with no point-of-use re-derivation and not marked RELAYED-UNVERIFIED => flagged

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed a durable report asserting a relayed count as current with no re-derivation => flagged

acceptanceCriteria.text: The family cure is REAL only if it can FAIL: each artifact-class gets a lint/gate that RENDERS-STALE or REDs when its invariant breaks, WITH a stub-must-fail (a seeded broken artifact of that class observed RED before the gate counts as wired). Generalizes R40.54 evidence-must-fail from a single AC to the whole family. A class whose gate has never been shown RED on its own defect = UNPROVEN.

gateRef.assertion: each per-class gate has a registered RED observation on its own defect; a green-only (never-RED) class gate => UNPROVEN/RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): each class stub seeded with its defect must be observed RED before that class counts cured

acceptanceCriteria.text: A NEGATIVE / ABSENCE claim (grep=0, 'missing', 'absent', 'not implemented') is INADMISSIBLE until the INSTRUMENT is shown able to SUCCEED — a POSITIVE CONTROL attached in the same gate/report (the query returns >0 on a known-present target; the tool CAN find something). An absence-based ESCALATION (grep=0 -> BLOCKER) must carry its positive control at the FIRST escalation, else inadmissible. Would have stopped specimen #8 (resolveChangeRequest grep=0 relayed+escalated-to-Tron-3x on a WRONG name while approveChangeRequest EXISTS). The stub-must-fail IS the positive control: prove the query finds a known-present thing before trusting its 0.

gateRef.assertion: a negative/absence claim (or an absence-escalation) with no attached positive-control (instrument-proven-able-to-succeed) => RED/inadmissible

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed a grep=0 absence-claim with no positive control => RED; positive-control present (query finds a known target) => admissible

acceptanceCriteria.text: A claim about a COMPOSED system (ARMED, wired, deployed, covered end-to-end) must present EVIDENCE FROM EACH PART of the pairing — NOT one half + inferred whole. Concretely: client-marker-present AND sink-returns-403-not-404; producer AND consumer; payload AND rendered-artifact; local-emit AND passive-2nd-client-received. Asserting the whole from one end is inadmissible (a proxy/one-half shares the whole's blind spot: assert the RENDERED artifact, not a proxy). This is BROADER than grep=0 and MUST fire on it. Fires on specimen #10 (client bundle 'ARMED' while server sink 404'd = capture INERT) and on the R40.70 local-emit-is-not-a-broadcast case.

gateRef.assertion: a composed-system claim presenting evidence from only ONE part of a required pairing => RED; each part must show its own evidence

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed an 'ARMED' claim with client-marker-only (sink unchecked/404) => RED; both halves evidenced (marker AND sink-403) => admissible

acceptanceCriteria.text: A STANDING repeat-directive ('repeat X every report', 'keep saying X', a carried blocker) is itself an authoritative artifact with no freshness — it re-injects a stale fact on every cycle (WORSE than a one-time relay). It MUST carry a RE-DERIVE-BEFORE-REPEAT clause: what it asserts is re-derived at point-of-use each repeat, never relayed-from-store — especially a BLOCKER, re-derived at each report. This is derive-per-read applied to the reporting loop itself. Fires on specimen #9 (planner carried 'T40.1 BLOCKED: resolveChangeRequest grep=0' in its anchor + every report for days under a keep-repeating instruction; the close-path approveChangeRequest existed all along).

gateRef.assertion: a standing repeat-directive (esp. a carried blocker) with no per-repeat re-derivation of what it asserts => flagged; a re-asserted stale blocker => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126, nothing built yet): seed a carried blocker re-asserted across reports with no re-derivation => flagged/RED; a per-repeat re-derived claim => admissible

acceptanceCriteria.text: constraint-liveness / circular-ruling (specimen #6, a stored CONSTRAINT/RULING that read as an authoritative plan but was a DEADLOCK from birth — unsatisfiable/non-live, and it SILENTLY blocked work). SPLIT CURE, honest about what is CI-gatable: (1) CI-FAILABLE HALF — a stored ruling/constraint that gates work MUST render VISIBLY BLOCKED when read (liveness surfaced at point-of-use), NEVER silently block; a constraint that halts work with no visible-blocked render => RED. This half IS gated. (2) AUTHORING-DISCIPLINE HALF — satisfiability/no-deadlock at AUTHORING time (the author checks a ruling is live/achievable before issuing it) is NOT generically CI-lintable (you cannot statically prove an arbitrary governance ruling is satisfiable). It is EXPLICITLY ENROLLED as cure=authoring-discipline, NOT-CI-GATED-BY-NATURE, with this WRITTEN REASON (asymmetry rule R40.55: an exemption carries a written reason + stays visible, never a silent carve-out). This is honest-enumeration, not silent-pass — it satisfies AC-8's 'triage-flag not silent' rather than faking a CI gate (faking one would itself be the born-false 'coverage-claimed / nothing-enforces-it' disease this family kills).

gateRef.assertion: a stored ruling/constraint that gates work with no visible-blocked render at read => RED (CI-failable half); the authoring-satisfiability half is enrolled-not-CI-gated-by-nature with a written reason, flagged if that reason is absent

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): (CI half) seed a stored constraint/ruling that silently blocks work (no visible-blocked render) => RED; (enrollment half) a constraint-liveness cure marked not-CI-gated with NO written reason => flagged (must be reasoned + visible, not silent — R40.55 dead-exemption/asymmetry)

model.armStructure: Arm A (WENT-STALE->freshness): derive OR revalidate+visible-stale+show-age. Arm B (BORN-FALSE->provenance): positive-control for negative claims + other-half for composed/pairing claims + re-derive-before-repeat for standing directives. Arm B validates the INSTRUMENT + demands the OTHER HALF (revalidation alone re-confirms a born-false claim).
model.reInspectionClose: Architect re-inspected the Arm-B ACs (read off origin/main, applied Arm-B to their own read = positive control), PASS on ACs 11/12/13 + meta AC-1; found ONE gap: specimen #6 constraint-liveness was enumerated (AC-8) but ungated = the enumerated-but-ungated born-false shape. FIXED with AC-class-constraint-liveness (split: CI-failable visible-blocked half + explicit authoring-discipline enrolled-not-CI-gated-by-nature half with written reason) — chose a hybrid over the architect's (b) so the gatable half is actually gated and the un-gatable half is honestly marked, not faked.
